limits: Optional coordinator only: direct helper callers retain their old per-instance budgets.
Bounds helper calls and conservative quote reservations, not model tokens or all external effects.
POSIX local process locks are not a distributed lock or verified Windows implementation.
Trusted operator-owned journal required: hashes are not signatures and cannot detect a consistent whole-journal rollback.
Wall-clock rollback is detected relative to surviving records; a manipulated OS clock is not cryptographically trusted.
Late/unknown results are retained for reconciliation without automatically retrying or releasing consumed allowance.
No hard real-time dispatch/cancellation guarantee is claimed; a deadline can expire while an already-started worker runs.
Six competing processes demonstrate budget safety, not guaranteed progress or a measured throughput improvement.
